title: Fix email validation duplicate detection logic

requirements.text: Fix the duplicate email detection logic in the createLead function to properly check if an email already exists in the Leads collection before inserting a new record. The current implementation incorrectly returns 'This email is already registered' for every submission.

quotes: Currently it incorrectly shows "This email is already registered" for every submission

acceptanceCriteria: Before inserting a new Lead record, query the Leads Map to check if any existing record has the same email
Only return the error 'This email is already registered' if a matching email is actually found in the collection
If no existing email is found, successfully insert the new Lead record and return success
Email comparison must be case-insensitive (convert both emails to lowercase before comparison)
The database query correctly iterates through the Leads Map values to check for email matches

requirements.text: Verify the form submission flow correctly handles both duplicate and unique email submissions, displaying appropriate success or error messages to the user.

quotes: After fixing, test the submission flow

acceptanceCriteria: When submitting a form with a new email, the success message is displayed and the form resets
When submitting a form with an existing email (case-insensitive match), the error message 'This email is already registered' is displayed
Error states are properly cleared when the user modifies the form and resubmits

constraints: Maintain the existing Lead type structure and Map-based storage implementation
Do not modify the frontend form UI components beyond error handling logic
Preserve the existing useCreateLead mutation hook structure
nonGoals: Adding email format validation beyond duplicate checking
Implementing email verification or confirmation flows
Changing the database storage mechanism from Map to a different structure
Adding bulk email import or management features
